title: add a debounce option to the searchBox
body:
After much thinking, even the searchHook will not be the right solution to implement debounce ONLY at the searchbox level.

The search hook will only be able to debounce globally, which is not what we are looking for.

So we should provide an option to debounce the searchBox, mostly for those reasons:
- very heavy interfaces (lot of facets, lot of images, ..)
- mobile experiences

We could implement a searchBox hook but I feel like everyone will then have to reimplement his own debounce, and users might not even know what is a debounce, or how to implement one or use one correctly.

Just import {debounce} from lodash should be sufficient.

comments.body: I was wrong again, we should be modular on those kind of things, see #884. Implementing a debouc algorithm (and good one) would mean including lodash.debounce for everyone. Which is not a good idea and not very modular
